title: metadata + runtime: loose ends of the per-member registry keys and the fallback host's action doors: event kind, orphaned member, view inference, MCP pins (follow-up of #32517)
body:
domain:server#2 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CaP1iy4RSEQbW6177G

立卡门 ① · 已落地工作欠的后续：#32517（PR #32687）契约审查 r1/r2 的非阻塞项。按 Bill「简单的问题后续单独立卡」从 PR 中拆出。Part of #31527 (ADR-0150)。Blocked-by #32517.

## What

PR #32687 keys bundled types per member in the in-memory registry and `MemoryLoader`, answers the package-less plural read per `(package, name)`, and narrows the fallback host's action doors. These loose ends were left for a separate PR; none changes a served answer:

1. A second locale of a bundled item emits `added` where a rewrite would say `changed` (`packages/metadata/src/metadata-manager.ts` ~:1047); rule which is right and pin it.
2. After a package takes over a package-less bundled item, a bare non-canonical member can be left orphaned (`packages/metadata/src/package-slotted-store.ts` ~:475); pin or clean it.
3. `latestMemberOf` infers "this is a view" from "no write was ever recorded"; make it an explicit flag or pin the inference.
4. Fallback host: `list_actions` / bare `run_action` (MCP) are declared in the changeset but unpinned; the two-packages-on-one-object case of the fallback activation and execution doors has no pin.
5. Docs in the PR's own text: the caller table omits objectql `runGovernanceInventory`; a #32246 pin titled "unchanged" was rewritten (name the epic ruling in its title).

## Acceptance

- Pins for items 1–4, red under ablation where they guard a branch.
- `Clause-②: no` unless item 1's ruling moves an answer (then declared FROM → TO).

## 业务理由

谁受益：维护元数据注册表与 action 门的开发者。场景：后续改动悄悄改了事件类型或回退宿主的 MCP 答案，没有测试会红。不做：已声明的答案和推断可被无声回退。

## 读者

server 车道，PR #32687 合并后；起点上列文件与 PR #32687 的复审记录。

## 查重

`repo:objectstack-ai/objectstack is:issue latestMemberOf list_actions fallback` → 0 hits. #32689 (composed-stack activation 404→409) is separate. No duplicate.
